issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מִקְוֵה אֲבוֹתֵיהֶם יְהוָה' means 'the hope of their fathers, the LORD' (i.e., the LORD is the hope of their fathers). The Chinese renders 'מִקְוֵה' as '池子' (pool/pond), which is a mistranslation; the word here means 'hope' or 'expectation,' not a pool. This changes the meaning of the verse.
